text:
paul (partnerships): FYI StrataCore asked for a compact joint benchmark: perf/W + throughput for rdx-13b on their S100 card. They want a reproducible lab run and a smaller SI-run. Need telemetry schema, install window, and a brief marketplace blurb template.

erin (perf-eng): Ok. Proposal: 1) Smoke: 3x 20m runs at seq=256/512/1024 to find knee. 2) Tuning: kernel-flag sweep (single-flag flips) with 30m steady-state windows. Report perf/W time-series + last-10m steady avg.

dave (eng-runtime): Telemetry needs: pmbus.power_w, pmbus.temp_c, host.rapl_w, kernel.op_ms_p50/p95, batch.lat_p95, thermal.throttle_count. For SI we'll accept per-minute CSV aggregates. Lab sampling: PMBus 10Hz, RAPL 2Hz.

yuki @StrataCore: We can ship probe kits and a wiring PDF. Our card firmware can disable smoothing for steady reads. Kit ETA week of Aug 9. SI site (Niko) can do per-minute CSVs only.

niko (si-ops): Confirmed. SI rack-7 available Aug 13-14. We'll collect per-minute CSV: timestamp,card_id,power_w,temp_c,throttle_flag,run_tag. Need run_tag mapping from lab.

notifier-bot: Calendar event created: "StrataCore x Redwood: bench + SI validation" Aug 11 10:00 PT (install), Aug 13 09:00 PT (runs).

paul (partnerships): Action items:
- dave: publish telemetry_schema_sc1.json (include compatibility notes for CSV)
- erin: upload workload matrix csv + perf/W calc method (instant + steady avg)
- yuki: share kit ETA, wiring pdf, recommended firmware flag
- niko: confirm SI CSV drop path and ACLs

erin (perf-eng): I'll normalize perf/W both raw and normalized-to-TDP; annotate kernel flags and runtime/git SHAs for reproducibility. Workload matrix to s3 by EOD Fri.

dave (eng-runtime): Opening PR with schema + a tiny harness that emits jsonl to s3. For SI: conversion tool from per-minute CSV -> jsonl with run_tag mapping. Example lab cmd: 

$ rw-bench run --model rdx-13b --seq 1024 --qps 100 --dur 30m --telemetry telemetry_schema_sc1.json --run_tag sc-lab-1024-kf-default

yuki @StrataCore: We'll include firmware note: set power_smoothing=0, recommend BIOS perf preset. Kit ships Aug 8 arrives Aug 9. Wiring PDF in DM.

niko (si-ops): We'll push CSVs to s3://redwood-perf/stratacore/1819999999/si_csvs/ with ACL restricted to redwood_stratacore_team. Serial console enabled.

erin (perf-eng): One request: capture ambient temp and PSU model in metadata for each run; helps explain perf/W deltas.

dave (eng-runtime): Adding ambient_temp_c and psu.model fields to schema. Will log runtime and kernel git SHAs.

paul (partnerships): On comms: I'll draft a 2-paragraph marketplace blurb template that legal and marketing will approve before any public posting. We won't publish numbers or logos without signoff.

yuki @StrataCore: Understood. We'll sign NDA appendix for data sharing.

notifier-bot: Reminder set Aug 9 09:00 PT "Lab prep: StrataCore probe install".

paul (partnerships): Thanks all. We'll use this thread for quick updates only; post-run we'll collate an internal results doc and artifact bundle (telemetry, CSVs, BIOS snapshots) for signoff.
